body:
Adds one LoLa integration test covering repeated `OfferService`, `StopOfferService`, `StartFindService`, `Subscribe` and `Unsubscribe` calls. It compares discovered service identity/cardinality after duplicate offers, verifies absence after each stop, checks subscribed state and rejection after each unsubscribe, and verifies sample delivery and recovery with finite deadlines. The harness requires the application to exit 0.

Repeated discovery uses the same callback and instance specifier. Each returned search operation is checked for unchanged discovered service state and stopped; distinct operation handles follow the native implementation and existing watch-sharing/callback tests. Production APIs are unchanged.

The existing copyright checker BUILD/MODULE.bazel input strings are also corrected to filesystem paths. This root BUILD change is isolated from the new test directory for independent review.

Relates to #1167.

The original merge-tree verification on upstream `c77751819b8885a902540dbef7f0fe25cf85d51c` is retained in [fork Host run 37637574398](https://github.com/jnsagai/communication/actions/runs/37637574398):

- GCC15 build, 507 tests and separate module integration build passed; seven tests skipped.
- ASan/UBSan/leak: 506 passed, eight skipped; the new integration/schema tests passed.
- TSan: 404 passed, 110 skipped. Native test rules exclude Docker integration tests under TSan (Ticket-249859); the new schema test passed.
- Ruff and clippy passed. Clang-tidy analysis passed, but its GitHub SARIF-upload step failed. The unchanged report was subsequently accepted and processed through the fork's Code Scanning API; the original failed job remains recorded.

Clang-tidy reported three warnings in the new test. The follow-up commit extracts repeated discovery checks while preserving callback storage for the whole test, uses a reference to the instance specifier, and gives the test entry point internal linkage. All existing assertions, finite waits, cleanup and the strict application exit-zero requirement remain. Native clang-format 19.1 checks pass. Full Host verification of the revised source is running in [fork Host run 37645549862](https://github.com/jnsagai/communication/actions/runs/37645549862), with source tree `b92aee532c1d553b89d0123b8861e2e925113853` matching native GitHub merge object `80b6c017da7e2c39647b031c42c5e893fbda70b2` based on upstream `cef680454e8586daca9f953084dca33fb3759d0c`. Earlier results above belong to the explicitly identified predecessor merge tree.

Current PR head: `4683338ab53393d16e0a3eb1aa5c8c27e1728057`. Strict Eclipse ECA validation passed for its author and committer. No sign-off or agreement signature was added.

Fresh copyright comparison on the revised merge tree and upstream `cef680454e8586daca9f953084dca33fb3759d0c` reports 200 identical baseline/candidate findings, with no additions from this PR. The upstream documentation change removed five prior findings and added one, reducing the earlier inherited count from 204 to 200. An explicit check over the nine contribution paths returns zero findings: seven files have native header templates; the two JSON configurations have no native header template. The full repository checker remains failed. Inherited header repair remains separate scope; no waiver is claimed.

QNX is excluded from this contributor verification as requested. The upstream Host workflow still requires maintainer approval to run, and code-owner approval and the merge queue remain outstanding. Fork CI evidence does not supply the required upstream GitHub statuses.
